repos.description: Open, source-linked dataset of real-world cyberattacks executed or orchestrated by AI agents. Every field cited, every grade honest. Data layer of Rogue Agent Watch.

repos.name: agentic-access-control
repos.description: Read-only, local-first dashboard showing what your AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, MCP servers) are actually allowed to do: permission rules with file provenance, MCP server inventory, sandbox & hook posture, risk findings, OWASP Agentic Top 10 threat scenarios, and config drift. No enforcement, no telemetry (for now).
